info.title: asking-ng API
info.description: Poll API, auth, admin, readiness, optional LLM gateway (Ollama / LM Studio; returns **503** `LLM_DISABLED` when **INCIDENT_MODE** is set). WebSocket live poll updates at GET /ws/poll/:id (same host/port as HTTP; behind Caddy with /api prefix: /api/ws/poll/:id). Optional **embed read token** gates public reads/votes when configured (`embed_token` query or **X-Poll-Embed-Token** header); WS upgrades also accept **`ws_bearer`** (same user JWT as HTTP `Authorization`) when the caller owns the poll — browsers cannot set WS headers, so use the query param. Optional signed webhooks; GET /poll/:id/meta for compact bot metadata; GET /poll/:id/embed for oEmbed (PUBLIC_SITE_URL); GET /poll/:id/export (api_key or owner JWT). WS upgrades honor `WS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` or `CORS_ORIGIN`, per-IP rate limits, per-poll cap — see stack.env.example.

phase.description: Initial lifecycle; default **open** (`draft` = no votes until phase changes).

open_at.description: Optional UTC ms epoch to auto-open voting (before this, effective phase is `draft`).

lock_at.description: Optional UTC ms epoch to auto-lock voting (effective phase becomes `locked`).

reveal_at.description: Optional UTC ms epoch to auto-reveal (effective phase becomes `revealed`).

boosted_voting_enabled.description: Enable weighted votes (`boost_weight` > 1 allowed on vote endpoint).

max_boost_weight.description: Max allowed `boost_weight` when boosted voting is enabled (default 3).

show_unweighted_values.description: When boosted voting is enabled, also expose raw unweighted counts in responses/exports.

run_of_show_key.description: Optional queue key for run-of-show grouping (same key = same sequence).

run_of_show_order.description: Optional order index within the run-of-show key.

vanity_slug.description: Optional short slug for redirects at `/s/{slug}` (lowercase letters, numbers, `-`).

next_poll_id.description: Optional linked poll id used by queue/bracket flows for next-step advancement.

auto_advance_on_close.description: When true, closing this poll (locked/revealed) can auto-open `next_poll_id`.

allow_write_in.description: Allow free-text vote values not present in `options`.

write_in_profanity_filter.description: Enable built-in profanity filtering for write-ins.

soft_throttle_max_votes_per_min.description: Max accepted votes per minute per source hash when `vote_friction_tier=soft_throttle`.

pow_difficulty.description: Leading-zero hex difficulty for SHA-256(pollId:nonce) when `vote_friction_tier=proof_of_work`.

show_notes.description: Private run-of-show notes; returned only to the signed-in owner on GET /poll/:id.

shared_editor_user_ids.description: Optional user IDs allowed to edit this poll while it remains in draft phase.

theme_preset.description: Optional per-poll visual preset for the public poll page.

selection_mode.description: `multi` = voters send **option_indices** (fixed options only; mutually exclusive with boosted voting and write-ins in v1). Defaults to **single**.

vote_eligibility.description: `anonymous` (default): public voting. `account`: voters must send `Authorization: Bearer` with a valid user JWT; one ballot per user.

generate_embed_read_token.description: When true, response includes one-time **embed_read_token** (store safely; only a hash is kept server-side).

webhook_targets.description: Optional list of signed POST webhook targets.

secret.description: Optional signing secret; if omitted the server generates one and returns it once in create response.

selection_mode.description: Editable only while the poll is in **draft**; incompatible with boosted voting and write-ins.

panic.description: When **true**, sets **phase** `locked`, **voting_paused** `true`, and **pause_message** (from this body if provided, else `PANIC_PAUSE_MESSAGE`, else a default). Must be sent alone except optional **pause_message**; triggers WebSocket `{ type: "panic" }`.

schema.description: Send at least one field. **panic**: true alone (or with **pause_message** only) is a kill switch; do not combine with phase, voting_paused, expiration, show_notes, or embed rotation.
